projects.name: NMDOT ESTIP Project Locations by Year - Project Locations 2025
projects.notes: NMDOT eSTIP project lines for federal fiscal year 2025 (layers 0 and 1 are FFY 2023 and 2024). STALE: the ArcGIS Online item was last updated in 2023 and there is no layer for FFY 2026 or later, so most of these are let or built by now. No description, phase or letting date; FFY_LIST is the programmed year. PRG_PRIOR / PRG_2018..PRG_2021 / PRG_FUTURE are programmed dollar amounts (0 in the sample). LEAD_AGY, DIST_MPO, RouteID + FromMeasure/ToMeasure also present.

projects_note: No current (FFY 2026+) NMDOT STIP geometry service was found in NMDOT's ArcGIS Online org. NMDOT's live eSTIP is a web application, not checked for an open GIS feed.
parcels_statewide_note: null: no free statewide New Mexico parcel layer with owner names was found (ArcGIS Online search returned only land-management/ownership-class layers).

parcels_counties.notes: Santa Fe County's own server (layer TaxParcels, GISEDIT.ASSESSOR.TaxParcels). The record queries that timed out on 2026-11-17 now answer in a few seconds with resultRecordCount=3. ownernme1 is filled on 90,638 of 90,754; ownernme2 is a second owner. CAUTION: several columns hold values that do not match their names/aliases in the three sample records: 'waterserv' (alias Water Service Provider) holds the acreage as text ('1.1890' where the legal description says 1.189 AC, same for 1.11 and 4.85), 'building' and 'unit' hold a city and state ('EDGEWOOD','NM'), 'pstlzip4' repeats the 5-digit zip, and the value columns (lndvalue, prvassdval, cntassdval, txblvalyrchg ...) look shifted too, so no market-value field is mapped. lowparcelid is the 19-digit UPC; parcelid is a shorter account-style number. Owner names carry trailing spaces. maxRecordCount 2000.

summary: Projects: only an out-of-date NMDOT eSTIP line layer (FFY 2023-2025) verified, nothing current. Parcels: no statewide owner layer; Bernalillo, Dona Ana and Sandoval county layers with owner names verified (Santa Fe has owner fields but its server timed out on queries).
parcels_counties_note_2026_11_23: Added 2026-11-23: Santa Fe (now answering), San Juan, Valencia, Lea, Otero (City of Alamogordo copy), Chaves, Eddy (City of Carlsbad copy with terms forbidding download), Rio Arriba, Taos, Luna, Grant. Not found or not usable: McKinley (the only listing is the State Engineer's County_Parcels_2021 service on gis.ose.state.nm.us, whose host name did not resolve), Curry (maps.currycounty.org/arcgis returns 404), Los Alamos (county server gis.losalamosnm.us timed out twice; the ArcGIS Online copy Parcels_Complete has OWNER = 'PVT' class codes, not names, and dates from 2019). Statewide: none; the state DoIT account GDITAdmin only catalogues pointers to each county's own service ('Parcels - NM - <County>'), several of them dead, and the State Engineer's 2021 compilation host did not resolve.
